hook: Your phone screen can go completely black through your sunglasses.
title: Your Screen Goes Black Through Sunglasses
description:
Try this in 10 seconds. Hold polarized sunglasses in front of an LCD screen and slowly tilt them sideways. Many LCDs emit polarized light, so at one angle the glasses block it and the screen goes dark. It works best on LCD screens, and some phone screens will only dim.

#Shorts #Tech #PhoneTricks
